sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "player"."Club_ID" AS e, SUM("player"."Points") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("player"."Tries" - "player"."Apps") AS REAL) / "player"."Apps")) AS m2 FROM "player" GROUP BY "player"."Club_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player.relative difference of tries scored from appearances
why: total of points scored per club (by Club_ID) (additive)
(tries scored - appearances) / appearances: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of tries scored from appearances per club (by Club_ID)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of tries scored from appearances (all level)
